notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (7)': My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal (posted 'My Lord Is That Legal/Sure it is'), Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, Coruscant: Galactic Senate (posted 'Senate Chamber'), Prepared Defenses, 'Security Control', You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points, I Will Find Them Quickly, Master; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Security Control' (a starting effect) is printed as written: the only Security Control is a Light Coruscant effect, and no Dark card of that name exists.

Posted 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'EJP Dengar' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'ECC Iggy' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'ECC 4-LOM' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'EPP (AI) Aurra Sing' Aurra Sing (AI) (the strategy says he calls the AI Aurra Sing 'EPP Aurra' as a joke).

Posted 'Suckass in ship' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter (the strategy mentions '4-LOM riding in Zuckess'); 'The Phantom Gayness' dested The Phantom Menace; 'TINT/Oppressive' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'Weapon Lev' dested the Dark Weapon Levitation (Cloud City); 'Mos EspaDocking Bay' dested the Dark Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay.
Posted 'Tikkles', 'Orn Free Ta', 'Ask More' and 'Price Xizor' dested Tikkes, Orn Free Taa, Aks Moe and Prince Xizor.

The title and strategy claim the deck won the DragonCon (2001) Open, losing only to Praskac's WYS in the final; the wiki has no 2001 DragonCon event page, so the deck is kept as a general DeckTech list.
